title: Recursive Code Evolution for Task-Oriented Semantic Communications
abstract: arXiv:2610.29641v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Semantic communication jointly optimizes inference accuracy, channel use, and computation, yet the underlying communication program is typically specified before training. This paper presents ComRSI (Communications-Oriented Recursive Self-Improvement), a framework for recursively evolving that program through large-language-model-assisted code edits. A fixed agent modifies the encoder, channel adapters, decoder, loss, and training policy; a protected evaluator screens candidates under prescribed budgets and resource constraints. Accepted code and textual feedback inform subsequent proposals, while candidate weights are trained from scratch. In the original ten-generation CIFAR-100 lineage, eight accepted revisions produce an attention-pooled code achieving 74.3% test accuracy over an Additive White Gaussian Noise (AWGN) channel at 32 complex symbols per image, compared with 67.2% at 256 symbols for the initial design. translated_title: 面向任务的语义通信的递归代码演进
translated_abstract: 语义通信联合优化推理精度、信道使用和计算资源，但底层的通信程序通常在训练开始前就已固定。本文提出了ComRSI（面向通信的递归自我改进），一个通过大语言模型辅助的代码编辑来递归演进该通信程序的框架。一个固定的智能体负责修改编码器、信道适配器、解码器、损失函数和训练策略；一个受保护的评估器在规定的预算和资源约束下筛选候选方案。被接受的代码和文本反馈会为后续提案提供指导，同时候选模型的权重从零开始训练。在最初的十代CIFAR-100演化谱系中，八次被接受的修订产生了一个注意力池化代码，在每张图像32个复符号的加性高斯白噪声（AWGN）信道条件下实现了74.3%的测试精度，而初始设计需要256个符号才达到67.2%的精度。
tldr: 该论文提出ComRSI框架，通过大语言模型辅助的递归代码自我改进来自动演进语义通信程序，最终仅用每张图像32个复符号就实现了74.3%的测试精度，优于使用8倍符号资源的初始设计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ComRSI, a framework that recursively evolves communication programs through LLM-assisted code edits, achieving 74.3% test accuracy with only 32 complex symbols per image, outperforming the initial design that required eight times more symbols.
